name: Stella Caro
source:
imouto DeaMachina.

The imouto of Caro familiy. As DeaMachina suffer from illness related to her hiseki which acts as her power source, due to her illness she is unable to turn into human although she has gained self-awarness as machina. Has gentle character. To cure her sickness the Caro family travels to new continent Elysium.

Her hiseki seems to hold some secrets.
